_comment: The validated MISRA toolchain: every tool ru-misra and the tool-validation suite run, pinned to a version and,
where it is downloaded, to its SHA-256. tools/misra/install.py installs from this file only, so a scan and the
validation always run the same tools. Changing any entry changes a validated tool: the self-CI fails until the
validation has been re-run and its record (tests/misra-validation/validation-record.json) re-committed
(docs/tool-validation/plan.md, Re-validation). Compilers come from the runner image's signed Ubuntu archive;
their exact versions are recorded at every run, so an image update that changes one fails the record check too.

codeql_bundle.why: the CodeQL CLI the coding-standards release supports (its supported_codeql_configs.json)

coding_standards_script.why: indexes the generated deviation configuration into the database (the pack's documented mechanism)

host.codeql_build_why: Ubuntu's default GCC, invoked as g++: the compiler family the pack recognises, and the same family as arm-none-eabi-g++
